Pre-Qualification Criteria These Terms and Conditions govern your participation as a bidder in any bid init iated on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) platform by any department, org anization, or Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) of the Government of Gujarat. By submitting a bid, you agree to be bound by these Terms, in addition to all applic able GeM policies, guidelines, statutory provisions, and specifically, the Gujarat State Procurement Policy 2024. 1. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) All bidders are mandatory to submit an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) as per be low detail. (As per the Gujarat State Procurement Policy 2024). The EMD must be in the form of a Demand Draft (DD). Demand Draft Details: The DD must be drawn in DD Amount Amount mentioned in BID docu ment (In Rs.) In favor of Principal, Government Polytech nic, Rajkot Bank Detail State Bank of India Bhaktinagar branch, Rajkot The DD should clearly state the BID reference number and the bidder's name. Uploading a Scanned Copy: Bidders must upload a scanned copy of the DD to the GeM Portal. The scanned copy should be clear and legible, ensuring all details of the DD are visible. The uploaded document will be considered as proof of EMD submission. Physical Submission of DD: In addition to uploading the scanned copy, bidders are required to submit the or iginal physical copy of the DD. The physical DD must reach the designated offic e/address mentioned in the BID document no later than three (3) days from the

bid end date. Late Submission: Failure to submit the physical DD within the stipulated timefr ame will result in disqualification from the bid process. The uploaded scanned c opy will not be considered a valid substitute for the physical DD. Rejection: The EMD will be rejected if the details on the physical DD do not match the deta ils on the uploaded scanned copy, or if the DD is not drawn in the specified form at or on the designated bank. Any discrepancies may lead to disqualification. Refund: EMDs of unsuccessful bidders will be returned as per the terms and conditions s pecified in the bid document. Eligibility criteria for Exemption in EMD: a) Micro & small-scale enterprises which participate directly in tendering proce ss for the product which they are manufacturing / service which they are pro viding and have Udyam registration for items / service under procurement a nd having Registration with CSPO or National Small Industries Corporation b) Startups which participate directly in tendering process for the product whic h they are manufacturing / service which they are providing and recognised by DPiIT under the Start-up India Program and has obtained Udyam registrati on & CSPO/NSIC registration as MSE c) Organization which has registration certificate for the manufacturing produc t of the tender, from Gujarat Khadi Gramodyog Board or Khadi and Village In dustries Commission (K.V.I.C) or Commissioner of Cottage Industries. d) Board/Corporations/PSUs of the Central/State Government for their own man ufactured items e) State Government recognized organizations like (i) organizations for blinds, dumb and deaf, disabled, mentally disabled persons; (i) women's self-help gr oup recognized by Gujarat Livelihood Promotion Company; which participate directly in tendering process for the product which they are manufacturing / service which /they are providing f) Sellers who have got their credentials verified through the process of Vendor Assessment by Vendor Assessment Agencies hrough GeM for the Primary Pr oduct/Primary Service for which Bid/RA floated on GeM. g) In keeping with GeM guidelines, OEM and service providers rendering servic es directly or by its own and having annual turnover of INR 500 Crore or mor e. h) In keeping with GeM guidelines, Sellers/Service Providers holding BlS licens e for the Primary Product Category whose credentials are validated through BIS database.

2. Turnover as per GeM Bid: · Bidders must meet the minimum average annual turnover requirement is tw ice of the estimated bid value as per the purchase policy 2024 of Governmen t of Gujarat. · This turnover will typically be calculated based on the last three completed financial years preceding the bid opening date, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year. · Bidders must submit valid documentary evidence, such as audited financial statements or a certificate from a Chartered Accountant/Cost Accountant ind icating turnover details for the relevant period, to substantiate their declared turnover. · In cases where the bidder's constitution/incorporation date is less than thre e years, the average turnover for the completed financial years since constit ution shall be considered. · Exemption for MSEs and Startups (as per GeM and GSPP 2024): Micro and S mall Enterprises (MSEs) as per latest MSME rules, and Startups recognized b y DIPIT under the Startup India Program with Udyam registration, shall be ex empted from the "Bidder Turnover" criteria, subject to meeting quality and t echnical specifications. Supporting documents proving eligibility for such exe mptions must be uploaded with the bid. 3. Experience as per GeM Bid: · Bidders must possess the requisite experience as explicitly outlined in the s pecific GeM bid document. · This may include a requirement for successfully completing a certain numb er of similar projects or supply orders within a specified number of years. · The bid document will detail the type, value, and period of experience requi red. · Bidders shall provide copies of relevant contracts/work orders, completion c ertificates, and any other supporting documents as evidence of their experie nce. · Exemption for MSEs and Startups (as per GeM and GSPP 2024): MSEs and St artups shall be exempted from the "Experience Criteria," provided they meet the quality and technical specifications of the bid. Supporting documents pro ving eligibility for such exemptions must be uploaded with the bid. 4. Registered Office Within State (Based on Gujarat Government GeM Policy 2024) · Local Preference: As per the Gujarat State Procurement Policy 2024, prefere nce may be given to bidders whose registered office or a functional full-time branch office is located within the State of Gujarat (specifically, Ahmedabad/ Gandhinagar or as specified in the bid document).

· Bidders claiming this preference must provide valid documentary evidence ( e.g., GST registration with Gujarat address, Udyam Registration, or a certifica te from a competent authority) to prove their registered office/branch office l ocation in Gujarat. · The specific weightage or preference extended to bidders from Gujarat will be explicitly mentioned in the bid document and will be in accordance with t he prevailing Gujarat State Procurement Policy 2024. Instruction to Bidder 1. Invitation for Bid (IFB) and Submission Portal This tender is invited for the engagement of a servic e provider for Unskilled Manpower services to support office and laboratory functions at Government P olytechnic, Rajkot, Gujarat. All interested and eligible bidders are required to submit their proposals exclus ively through the Government E-marketplace (GeM) portal. Bids submitted through any other mode w ill not be considered. 2. Unconditional Acceptance of Tender Terms As a confirmation of unconditional acceptance of all ter ms, conditions, and specifications stipulated in this tender document, the bidder is required to: Sign each page of this document. Affix the official company seal on each page. Upload a complete, scanned copy of the signed and sealed document as an integral part of their bid submission on the GeM portal. Failure to submit this acceptance will be grounds for bid rejection. 3. Bidder's Due Diligence Bidders are solely responsible for conducting their own due diligence prior to bid submission. This includes, but is not limited to, acquainting themselves with the site, working condition s, environmental factors, and any other prerequisites necessary for the successful execution of the contrac t. The Buyer (Government Polytechnic, Rajkot) shall not entertain any claims arising from a bidder's failure to obtain such necessary information. 4. Liability and Indemnification The service provider shall be solely and exclusively responsible for its d eployed personnel. In the event of any accident, injury, or death of the service provider's personnel, or any damage caused to a third party during the performance of the contract, the service provider shall bear all r esulting liabilities, claims, legal proceedings, and penalties. The service provider agrees to indemnify an d hold harmless Government Polytechnic, Rajkot, from any and all liabilities arising from such incidents. 5. Statutory Compliance with Wage Revisions The service provider must adhere to all directives issu ed by the Labour Commissioner's Office, Government of Gujarat. Any revisions to minimum wages or other statutory payments must be implemented with immediate effect. The service provider shall be required to submit documentary proof of such compliance to the competent authority at Government Polytechnic, Raj kot, as and when required. 6. Jurisdiction All disputes or differences arising out of or in connection with this tender and the subsequ ent contract shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Rajkot, Gujarat. To Whomever It May So Concern The bidder shall ensure strict adherence to the minimum wage rates stipulated in the circular issued by th e Labour, Skill Development and Employment Department, Government of Gujarat, dated 30.09.2025.

Furthermore, in the event of any revision to the minimum wages by the said authority during the contract period, the contractor shall be mandatorily required to implement the revised rates from the effective date . The financial implications of such statutory revisions will be addressed as per the contract terms. . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
